about.title: About HomieBites
about.description1: We serve fresh, home-cooked vegetarian meals from
about.description2: with daily delivery to nearby societies.
about.description3: Our food is prepared in a clean home kitchen using simple, traditional recipes—less oil, fresh ingredients, and the kind of taste you’d expect at home.
about.description5: our mission is to bring honest, home-style meals to your table every day.
about.whyChooseSubtitle: Traditional recipes, fresh ingredients, and the warmth of home cooking.
about.whyChooseIntro: We cook the way you would at home—simple, nutritious, and with care. No heavy spices or excess oil. Just roti, sabzi, dal, and rice made with traditional recipes and delivered fresh to your door.
about.cookStory: I grew up in a family where every meal was cooked at home—dal, sabzi, roti, and rice. Those recipes and that care are what we bring to HomieBites. Every dish is prepared in our home kitchen with the same attention to taste and hygiene.
about.cookExperience: Years of home cooking and a passion for simple, wholesome food.
about.familyRecipes: Many of our dishes come from family recipes passed down and refined over time—so you get authentic, homely flavours every day.
about.fssaiNote: We are FSSAI registered. You can verify our license number in the footer.
